chapter.verse: Keimah Paul, Silvanus, leh Timothy in Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris sunga om Thessalonica khuamite' pawlpi kong hopih uh hi. Note' tungah hehpihna leh nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Ka thungetnate uhah na min uh lo denin note khempeuh' hangin Pasian' kiangah lungdam ka ko tawntung uh a,
upna tawh na sepnate uh, itna tawh na hanciamnate uh leh i Topa Jesu Khris sunga lametna kiptak na neihnate uh i Pa Pasian' mai-ah ka pulak uh hi.
Pasian' hong it sanggamte aw, Pasian in note hong teelkhia khin ahihlam ka thei uh hi.

A hang pen kong tangkokhiat uh Lungdamna Thu, note' kiangah kam bek tawh hilo-in vangliatna tawh, Kha Siangtho tawh, telcianna a dimtak tawh hong tung ahi hi. Note' phattuam nadingin note' lakah kote bangci mi hong hi cih teltak nong theih uh ahi hi.
Note zong gimna nakpi thuak kawm mahin Pasian' thu na sang uh a, Kha Siangtho lungdamna tawh komau leh Topa a ettehte na suak uh hi.
Tua hangin Macedonia gam leh Achaia gam sunga thu-um khempeuh' ading etteh lim khat na suak uh hi.

A hang pen Macedonia gam leh Achaia gam sungah note' tungtawnin Topa' thu a gingkhia bek hilo-in Pasian' sunga na upna uh zong mun khempeuh ah va kizel ahih manin komau' gen ding bangmah kisam nawnlo hi.

A hang pen tua mite mah in ei tawh kisai thute tangko uh a, nong dawntuahzia uh thute ahi zongin, milim biakna pan Pasian' kiangah na kihei uh pen nungta-a a maan Pasian' na a sem ding na hihna uh ahi zongin,
vantung pana hong pai ama' Tapa, misite' lakpan a thawhkiksak, hong tung ding hehna pan eite hong honkhia ahi Jesu a ngak ding na hihna uh ahi zongin, hih thute tangko uh hi.
